ingredients.title: Chicken
items: 5 lbs frozen boneless, skinless chicken breasts
2 tsp Italian seasoning or ranch seasoning

ingredients.title: Cheese Sauce
items: 2 cups + 2 tbsp all-purpose flour (if watery add more)

instructions: Place frozen chicken into crockpot (some overlap is okay).
Sprinkle all dry seasonings evenly over chicken.
Pour broth around chicken (not directly on top of seasoning).
Cover and cook on HIGH for 5 to 6 hours.
Once cooked, shred chicken with forks directly in crockpot.
In a medium bowl, whisk 2 cups + 2 tbsp flour into 2–3 tbsp milk until smooth.
Add Velveeta™ cubes and butter. Melt until smooth.
Pour cheese sauce into shredded chicken, mix well.
Cook on LOW or WARM for 10–15 minutes until sauce is thick.
serving_suggestions: Great with toasted bread or inside a sandwich
storage: Refrigerator: Store leftovers in an airtight container for up to 4 days.
Freezer: Freeze in freezer-safe containers or bags for up to 3 months.
Reheating (Microwave): Heat in 30-second intervals, stirring between each interval, until heated through.
Reheating (Stovetop): Reheat over low heat, stirring occasionally. Add a splash of milk if the cheese sauce becomes too thick.
Food Safety: Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours of cooking.
Thawing: Thaw frozen leftovers overnight in the refrigerator before reheating for best texture.
